title: A two-spouted teapot for a gift exchange
prompt: Your friend group is doing a gift exchange at a holiday party, with a $30 spending limit. While browsing in a second-hand shop on Commercial Drive in Vancouver, you see this unusual teapot. Call the friend who organized the exchange, describe the teapot in detail, and explain whether you think it would make a good gift.

structure: Open the call, mention the gift exchange and give your first impression.
Describe the body (colour, dots, dial, legs) and the two very different spouts.
Describe the top (bamboo-style handle, lid, bird) and the infuser hanging from the spout.
Speculate on the purpose of the odd features, note the price and give a reasoned opinion.
modelAnswer: Hey Jordan, it's Mei. I'm in a second-hand shop on Commercial Drive, and I've found something that would be a total wild card for the gift exchange. It's a teapot, but a very eccentric one. The body is round and deep purple, dotted with white spots, and it's perched on three stubby gold legs. On the front, there's a white dial with a red needle, like a thermometer, so presumably it tells you how hot the tea is. What really throws you off is that it has two spouts: on the left, a long one that curves up, almost like a swan's neck, and on the right, a short, straight one. Dangling from the short spout on a chain, there's a little silver ball with tiny holes, probably a tea infuser. Instead of a side handle, there's a light brown, bamboo-style handle arching over the top, and a tiny yellow bird sits on the purple lid. It's $28, just under our limit. It's quirky, admittedly, but whoever ends up with it will have a story to tell. What's your take?

commonMistakes: Gọi mọi phần là 'the thing'; hãy dùng 'spout' (vòi), 'lid' (nắp), 'handle' (quai), hoặc diễn đạt vòng nếu quên từ.
Tả hai vòi nhưng không so sánh (dài/ngắn, cong/thẳng) — chi tiết đối lập giúp đạt điểm từ vựng cao.
Kết luận chỉ bằng "It's nice"; ở mức 9 cần lý do cụ thể (hợp giới hạn $30, tạo bất ngờ cho trò đổi quà).
